title: Flow-cytometry-based protocol to analyze respiratory chain function in mouse microglia
protocol: Dissect the required mice and perfuse with 10 mL ice-cold PBS.
Remove the brain and homogenize the tissue with a Dounce potter in dissection medium at 4°C (total volume 20 mL).
Transfer the cell suspension from each sample through a 70 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube respectively and spin at 300 g at 4°C for 5 min (total volume 20 mL).
Carefully remove the supernatant from each sample and resuspend the cell pellets in 10 mL 37% Percoll solution.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL Falcon tube respectively and centrifuge for 30 min at 800 g (without brake) at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend each cell pellet with 1 mL PBS at 4°C respectively.
Transfer the individual cell suspension to FACS tubes and centrifuge at 400 g at 4°C for 5 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 100 μL FC-Block and live/dead staining solution.
Incubate for 5 min on ice in the dark.
Add 2 mL FACS buffer and centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 50 μL of the surface markers labeling solution per sample (CD11b-APC and CD45-PE-Cy7; diluted in FACS buffer).
Incubate for 20 min in dark on ice.
Add 2 mL FACS buffer to the samples respectively and centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 500 μL staining solution containing MitoTrackerTM Green (final concentration 20 nM) and TMRM (final concentration 50 nM).
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C in the dark in a water bath.
Add 2 mL FACS buffer and centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 600 μL MAS buffer + PMP + TMRM solution.
Incubate for 2 min at 37°C in the dark to permeabilize the cells.
Record the basal mitochondrial membrane potential (Δψm) in the PE-channel for exactly 90 seconds.
Continue with a volume of 550 μL from the previous step and add 5.5 μL Pyruvate/malate working solution to achieve final concentrations of 5 mM Pyruvate and 2.5 mM Malate.
Vortex the mixture and record the Δψm for 90 seconds.
Continue with a volume of 500 μL from the previous step and add 5 μL FCCP working solution to achieve a final concentration of 1 μM FCCP.
Vortex the mixture and record the Δψm for 90 seconds.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 600 μL MAS buffer + PMP + TMRM solution.
Incubate the resuspended cells for 2 min at 37°C in the dark to permeabilize the cells.
Gate on single, live (FVD780-) CD11b+CD45low microglia.
Record the basal mitochondrial Δψm in the PE-channel for exactly 90 s.
Continue with a volume of 450 μL from the previous step.
Add 2 μL rotenone working solution (final concentration: 1 μM).
Vortex and record the Δψm for 90 s.
Record for 30 s with ddH2O.
Continue with a volume of 400 μL from the previous step.
Add 8 μL succinate (final concentration: 10 mM).
Vortex and record the Δψm for 90 s.
Record for 30 s with ddH2O.
Continue with a volume of 350 μL from the previous step.
Add 3.5 μL antimycin A working solution (final concentration: 20 μM).
Vortex and record the Δψm for 90 s.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 600 μL MAS buffer + PMP + TMRM solution.
Incubate the resuspended cells for 2 min at 37°C in the dark to permeabilize the cells.
Gate on single, live (FVD780-) CD11b+CD45low microglia.
Acquire mitochondrial membrane potential (Δψm) data in the PE-channel for exactly 90 seconds.
Continue with a volume of 450 μL from the previous step.
Add 2 μL rotenone working solution (final concentration: 1 μM).
Vortex and record Δψm for 90 s.
Record for 30 s with ddH2O.
Continue with a volume of 500 μL from the previous step.
Add 12.5 μL OAA (final concentration: 10 mM).
Vortex and record Δψm for 90 s.
Record for 30 s with ddH2O.
Continue with a volume of 400 μL from the previous step.
Add 8 μL succinate working solution (final concentration: 10 mM).
Vortex and record Δψm for 90 s.
Optional: Test various concentrations of OAA to inhibit CII function in cells.
Critical: Keep temperature at 37°C while acquiring sample for flow cytometry.
